requirement: A standalone server serves the shared hub behind HUB_SERVE, and another reads it before paying Google; a removal reaches the reader's cache through the revocation feed even with no read quota

oracle.ref: PR #1686 (feat); fix evidence: Before: the hub modules existed and were tested, but no server mounted their doors or ran their ticks, and no client read them
oracle.invariant: S1: client one pays Place Details once; the hub reads Google once to verify and publishes 1 snapshot; only identity, name, phone, address and location observations reach the hub. S2: client two makes 0 Place Details calls; its google-places source has coverage.provenance = hub and the hub's name and address. S3: the cached hub copy has dto null and revoked_at set; the brief research has no googlePlace, no google-places source and hubRevoked of length 1. S4: every cached place is checked again; one the hub no longer serves is revoked, one it cannot check now is not used, the cursor moves to the head. S5: each command exits 0 and the account, observation, place and picture change state; a revocation without --reason exits 2.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
